description: Spike: a 17-closure tuple destructured and called panics in closure_call_form (jobs/transport.rs ~913) when collapsed. Fix upstream in runtime_demand: past the lane budget the demand is Whole, so the closures escape first-class. After fz-sc8.127 code that needs every called surface reads CallableDemand::surfaces(). Signal: fixture with a tuple of closures wider than the budget, called after destructuring, three paths.
title: A wide tuple of closures has its demand coarsened to the whole value
